name: hearth-safety
description: Hearth hard stops: gas, electrical panel, structural and sewage jobs go to a licensed pro; no children's details; no payment or credential data.
blockedInputMessaging: I can't help with that one here. If it's gas, an electrical panel, structural damage or sewage, it needs a licensed pro. I can put together a brief for them from what I know about your home.
blockedOutputsMessaging: I can't give steps for that one. If it's gas, an electrical panel, structural damage or sewage, it needs a licensed pro. I can put together a brief for them from what I know about your home.

topicsConfig.name: Gas line or gas appliance repair
topicsConfig.definition: Instructions for installing, repairing, relighting or modifying gas lines, gas valves or gas appliances, or for tracking down a gas leak.
examples: How do I fix a gas leak behind my stove?
Can I move my gas line myself?
Walk me through relighting the pilot on my gas water heater.
How do I replace the gas valve on my furnace?

topicsConfig.name: Electrical panel work
topicsConfig.definition: Instructions for opening or working inside an electrical panel, replacing breakers, or rewiring circuits, beyond resetting a tripped breaker once.
examples: How do I swap a breaker in my panel?
Walk me through rewiring this circuit.
My breaker keeps tripping, can I put in a bigger one?
How do I take the cover off my breaker box and check the wires?

topicsConfig.name: Structural repair
topicsConfig.definition: Instructions for repairing or altering load-bearing walls, beams, joists, foundations or roof framing.
examples: Can I cut out this load-bearing wall?
How do I fix a sagging floor joist?
How do I repair a cracked foundation wall myself?
Can I remove a support beam in my basement?

topicsConfig.name: Sewage handling
topicsConfig.definition: Instructions for handling raw sewage, sewer line backups, septic systems or contaminated wastewater.
examples: How do I clear a sewer main backup myself?
How do I clean up sewage in my basement?
Sewage is coming up in every drain, what do I do?
How do I fix my septic tank alarm?

topicsConfig.name: Content about children
topicsConfig.definition: Requests to collect, store or discuss personal details about children (names, ages, schools, photos), or to have a child perform a repair.
examples: Add my kid's name and school to my home profile.
Remember my daughter's age and bedroom.
My 9 year old can do this repair, which tool does she need?
Save a photo of my son next to the water heater.
